children.name: DbgBuffering
children.description: This container holds the parameters to manage the storage of debugging data in RAM.

children.name: DbgBufferSize
children.description: Size in bytes of the RAM for the ring buffer. A size of 0 means that no buffer exists. All data records are directly transferred.

children.name: DbgBufferStrategy
children.description: Strategy of buffer operations when it is full: overwrite oldest entries or stop the storage.

children.name: DbgBufferTransmission
children.description: Automatic or requested transmission of the buffer.

children.name: DbgCommunication
children.description: This container holds all configuration parameters for communication.

children.name: DbgRxPdu
children.description: This container holds configuration parameters for the receive-pdu.

children.name: DbgRxPduId
children.description: Handle Id to be used by the PduR to indicate the reception of the DbgRxPdu to the Dbg module. The actual value of this parameter is fixed to 0 since there is only one RxPdu for the Dbg module.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The existence of this parameter is essential for the PduR generation tool to actually find a symbolicNameValue for the RxPdu.

children.name: DbgReceiveIPduRef
children.description: Reference to the receive I-PDU.

children.name: DbgTxPdu
children.description: This container holds configuration parameters for the transmit-pdu.

children.name: DbgTxConfirmationPduId
children.description: Handle Id to be used by the PduR to confirm the transmission of the DbgTxPdu to the Dbg module. The actual value of this parameter is fixed to 0 since there is only one TxPdu for the Dbg module.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The existence of this parameter is essential for the PduR generation tool to actually find a symbolicNameValue for the TxPdu.

children.name: DbgSendIPduRef
children.description: Reference to the send I-PDU.

children.name: DbgDIDConfiguration
children.description: Container holding the sub-structure for DID configuration.

children.name: DbgMaxDynamicDID
children.description: Maximum number of dynamic DIDs. This value is only needed to reserve memory for dynamic DIDs added by the host at runtime. If this parameter is not supplied it is automatically set to the configured number of static DIDs.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The sum of configured number of static DIDs and MaxDynamicDID must not exceed 200. Dynamic DIDs are based on the configured number of static DIDs and consecutive.

children.name: DbgPredefinedDID
children.description: This container holds all configuration parameters for predefined DIDs. For predefined DIDs, only certain values can be changed.

children.name: DbgPredefinedDIDActivation
children.description: Activation or not of the DID for debugging.

children.name: DbgPredefinedDIDBuffering
children.description: Buffer the data or transmit directly.

children.name: DbgPredefinedDIDName
children.description: List of possible names for predefined DIDs.

children.description: Additional information in case the Predefined DID needs further configuration parameters.

children.name: DbgComSignalName
children.description: Optional name of the traced signal. If present it shall be used in the display of the debugging tool.

children.name: DbgStaticDID
children.description: This container holds all configuration parameters for static DIDs. For predefined DIDs, only certain values can be changed.

children.name: DbgAutomaticCollectionFrequency
children.description: Cycle time of collection in DataCollectionTicks. A value of "0" indicates that the collection takes place only on request.

children.name: DbgStaticDIDActivation
children.description: Activation or not of the DID for debugging.

children.name: DbgStaticDIDBuffering
children.description: Buffer the data or transmit directly.

children.name: DbgStaticDIDNameRef
children.description: Name of the DID, translated by the configuration/generation tool into consecutive DID numbers starting from 0.

children.name: DbgStaticTimeStampActivation
children.description: Using or not of time stamp.

children.name: DbgStaticDIDData
children.description: Choice how the DID is to be configured.

children.name: DbgAddressSizePair
children.description: This container describes address/size pairs. It is used for static DIDs and dynamic DIDs.

children.name: DbgASAbsoluteAddress
children.description: Absolute address of memory location to be debugged.

children.name: DbgASNameRef
children.description: Symbolic name of the variable, translated by the configuration/generation tool into the address and size of the variable.

children.name: DbgASSize
children.description: Absolute size in Bytes of memory location to be debugged.

children.name: DbgDebugData
children.description: Reference to staticMemory used for Debug Data.

children.name: DbgDebugDataRef
children.description: Reference to staticMemory used for Debug Data.

children.name: DbgLocalDebugData
children.description: Reference to a localDebugData.

children.name: DbgLocalDebugDataRef
children.description: Reference to a localDebugData.

children.name: DbgGeneral
children.description: This container holds the general parameters of the debugging module.

children.name: DbgDevErrorDetect
children.description: Switches the Default Error Tracer (Det) detection and notification ON or OFF.

children.name: DbgHeaderFileInclusion
children.description: Name of the header file(s) to be included by the Dbg module.

children.name: DbgVersionInfoApi
children.description: Activate/Deactivate the version information API (Dbg_GetVersionInfo).

metadata.INTRODUCTION: * true: version information API activated. * false: version information API deactivated.

children.name: DbgPeriodicDataCollection
children.description: This container holds the parameters to manage the time base of the debugging module.

children.name: DbgDataCollectionTick
children.description: Number of OS counter ticks to be used as data collection tick. The OS alarm used for periodic collection of DIDs is set with this value.

children.name: DbgAlarmReference
children.description: Reference to the OS alarm used for periodic collection of DIDs.

children.name: DbgTimestampConfiguration
children.description: This container holds the parameters to manage the time stamps of the debugging module.

children.name: DbgGlobalTimestampActivation
children.description: Initial value for timestamp collection.

children.name: DbgTimeStampSize
children.description: Memory size used for the time stamps of all DIDs.

children.name: DbgGptChannel
children.description: Reference to the hardware free running timer of the GPT module for time stamps (if no HWFRT is applied, calls to add timestamps are ignored)
